title: Vertical Farms Raised $8 Billion, Then Funding Collapsed
hook: Vertical farms raised $8 billion. Then investors fled.
closing: Vertical farms proved hype cannot substitute for sustainable economics.
question: Would you eat vertical-farmed greens?

segments.say: Vertical farms raised $8 billion. The next funding period brought only a fraction as much.
One vertical farming company reached a $2.3 billion valuation, then shut down.
Vertical farm funding fell 91 percent after its peak. Investor enthusiasm vanished almost overnight.
